services.name: Trail Rides
services.desc: Beginners welcome! Join us for a fun and relaxing trail ride in our beautiful, serene Mount Forest location, approximately 1.5 hrs from Toronto airport, situated in the heart of Ontario CANADA Mennonite country (we are NOT in Alaska!!). Enjoy a spectacular outlook over the Saugeen River, ride through cool shady forest, green pastures, quiet country roads, and then the highlight of the trip riding your horse right through the Fairbanks River that runs through our property. No riding experience? That’s OK! Our rides are suitable for first timers and kids right through to experienced riders. We have horses suitable for all ages, sizes, and levels of riders. blurb: Guests can enjoy horseback trail rides through scenic areas including river crossings, riding lessons for all levels, pony rides for young children, carriage rides pulled by Clydesdale horses, and family horse experience days with grooming, riding, and mini pony games. The facility offers vacation rentals and hosts special events. Activities are beginner-friendly and suitable for families.
